acquisition method: an MS/MS scan to generate product ion spectra to determine amino acid sequence in consecutive scans starting from the most abundant peaks in the spectrum, and then selecting the next nine most abundant peaks
alkylation reagent: dithiothreitol and iodoacetamide were sequentially added before sequencing grade trypsin (Promega Corp., Madison, WI, United States) was added for digestion
cleavage agent: dithiothreitol and iodoacetamide were sequentially added before sequencing grade trypsin (Promega Corp., Madison, WI, United States) was added for digestion
enrichment method: The supernatants were subjected to sequential centrifugation (300 × g for 10 min, 2,000 × g for 20 min, 10,000 × g for 30 min) and ultracentrifugation (100,000 × g for 70 min at 4°C)
instrument: Thermo Scientific Q Exactive mass spectrometer
Extracellular vesicles protein identification was performed using nano-liquid chromatography-nanospray tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS/MS) on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: performed using nano-liquid chromatography-nanospray tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS/MS)
labeling: Proteomics data were summarized in Scaffold 4.9.0 (Proteome Software Inc., Portland, OR, United States) for spectral counting analysis.
reduction reagent: dithiothreitol and iodoacetamide were sequentially added before sequencing grade trypsin (Promega Corp., Madison, WI, United States) was added for digestion
